Bill.BriefDescription: Studying nitrogen contributions from on-site sewage systems in Hood Canal.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying nitrogen contributions from onsitesewage systems in Hood Canal; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that nitrogen isan important factor in creating lowdissolved oxygen in Hood Canal.The legislature further finds that inputs of nitrogen to Hood Canalfrom onsite sewage systems are uncertain due to insufficient data andstudies. Therefore, the legislature finds that improved data on thecontribution of nitrogen from onsite sewage systems to Hood Canalwould allow stakeholders to focus and prioritize resources. (2) The Puget Sound action team and the Hood Canal coordinatingcouncil shall contract for a study in the Hood Canal to: (a) Improve data and knowledge of the loading of nitrogen from onsite sewage systems to ground water; (b) Determine the local scale efficiency of nitrogen removal fromonsite sewage systems; and (c) Improve data and knowledge of the loading of nitrogen from allground water sources to Hood Canal. (3) The study shall: p. 1 2SHB 3287 (a) Locate representative onsite sewage systems distributed withinthe Hood Canal drainage basin for use in the study; (b) Collect water levels and samples from the areas around a numberof onsite sewage systems under a variety of water table, soil, andgeologic conditions; (c) Test samples for nitrogen, phosphorous, carbon, and otherpertinent chemistry; (d) Consider water levels and samples from monitoring wells both upgradient and down gradient from onsite sewage systems; (e) Collect data from drain fields to test onsite sewage systemefficiency; and (f) Collect water level, nutrient, and other chemical data from anumber of existing wells in the watershed to test how much nitrogen isreaching Hood Canal. (4) The study shall be coordinated with other studies beingconducted in Hood Canal through the Hood Canal dissolved oxygenprogram. (5) The Puget Sound action team and the Hood Canal coordinatingcouncil shall report their findings and recommendations to theappropriate committees of the legislature by December 1, 2007.
